description: This file implements a middleware component for managing ECMAScript (JavaScript) execution contexts using the Duktape engine, including context creation, evaluation, sandboxing, and interaction with ECMAScript functions for machine management.

methods.name: mach_make_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new context object for ECMAScript execution.

methods.name: mach_set_ctx
methods.description: Sets the global context pointer.

methods.name: mach_get_ctx
methods.description: Retrieves the current global context pointer.

methods.name: mach_dump_stack
methods.description: Outputs the current ECMAScript stack dump to a file.

methods.name: mach_set_spec_provider
methods.description: Sets the provider function and mode for ECMAScript context.

methods.name: mach_open
methods.description: Initializes the ECMAScript environment, loads default scripts, and sets up bindings.

methods.name: mach_close
methods.description: Releases the ECMAScript heap and cleans up.

methods.name: mach_eval
methods.description: Evaluates a string of ECMAScript code and stores the result.

methods.name: evalf
methods.description: Evaluates a formatted string as ECMAScript code.

methods.name: mach_process
methods.description: Calls the ECMAScript 'Process' function with given state and message.

methods.name: mach_match
methods.description: Calls the ECMAScript 'Match' function with pattern, message, and bindings.

methods.name: mach_set_spec_cache_limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the spec cache.

methods.name: mach_enable_spec_cache
methods.description: Enables or disables the spec cache.

methods.name: mach_clear_spec_cache
methods.description: Clears the spec cache.

methods.name: mach_make_crew
methods.description: Creates a crew JSON object with an ID.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Helper to execute ECMAScript functions and retrieve string results.

methods.name: mach_set_machine
methods.description: Calls ECMAScript 'SetMachine' with parameters.

methods.name: mach_rem_machine
methods.description: Calls ECMAScript 'RemMachine' with parameters.

methods.name: mach_crew_process
methods.description: Calls ECMAScript 'CrewProcess' with parameters.

methods.name: mach_get_emitted
methods.description: Retrieves emitted events from ECMAScript 'GetEmitted'.

methods.name: mach_do_emitted
methods.description: Processes emitted events with a callback function.

methods.name: mach_crew_update
methods.description: Calls ECMAScript 'CrewUpdate' with parameters.
